script.narration:
This dorm room could belong to anyone.
Same bed. Same desk. Blank walls.
But you'll be up at two finishing that assignment.
Squeezing in friends for one more game.
Your room has to hold a life you're still figuring out.
How do you make it yours?

Meet ReSpace.
Scan your room, choose what stays, and set a budget you're comfortable with.
Tell it how you want to live here: somewhere to concentrate, with room for friends.
ReSpace creates questions around your room and your goals, helping you work out the details.
Your answers build a taste profile: the colors and materials you like, and how you want the room to feel.
That guides a design with real products, planned around the furniture you're keeping.
Explore a photorealistic version of your room before buying anything.
Tap a piece to see its size, price and where to buy it.

Now picture a night here.
One more page.
One more game.
Apparently, 'one more' means different things to different people.

Need more room for your notebook? Ask for a smaller lamp, and explore the updated design.
See what other people are imagining for their rooms.
Share yours, and give someone else a place to start.

It's still the room you walked into.
But now, you can see yourself here.
ReSpace.
Make room for you.
Join the waitlist.
